Four ramps affect the Randolph Area. Two exit ramps connect Meadow Street and Harrison Street with traffic moving west from the central business district. One exit ramp near Harrison Street allows traffic moving east to exit onto Idlewood Avenue at the eastern project boundary. One entrance ramp at Meadow Street allows traffic to enter the Expressway heading east towards the central business district with the exception of the exit ramp on Idlewood Avenue which will not serve the Randolph Area, the ramps connect the Expressway with Meadow Street and Harrison Street, the major traffic carriers in the Project Area.
b. Construction: During the construction phase of the Downtown Expressway increased traffic demands will be placed
on Idlewood Avenue, Grayland Avenue, and Parkwood Avenue.
Idlewood Avenue, already congested with daily traffic,
will receive increased numbers of truck traffic. Accompanying the truck traffic will be increased noise, dust,
and emission levels. The excavation of the expressway
